name: User rack PC · 1U
source: User-measured: 15 in / 381 mm from mounting-ear contact plane to rear fascia; chassis 17 in / 431.8 mm wide, 19 in / 482.6 mm across ears. User-confirmed 1U; physical height 43 mm is PROVISIONAL, exact height to follow. Ports are editable photo-plane estimates from IMG_9051.JPG / IMG_9058.JPG, with rear checked against IMG_9057.JPG. Ear thickness unknown (2 mm preview), ear holes, socket sizes/recess, handles and side-stud envelopes are provisional. Manufacturer/model, mass, support/rail kit and load rating unknown. Direct mounting describes the ear datum, not a support certification. User annotated rear photo confirms DisplayPort above HDMI, five USB 2.0 ports, one USB 3.0 port and 1G Ethernet. Port centres remain photo estimates. See docs/user-pc-reference.md.
